beats.summary: Moving In: INT. WHITMORE PENTHOUSE, KITCHEN. EVENING. Claire stirs soup as the front door slams. Close-up: Claire’s hand tightens on the ladle, then relaxes.

audio_lines.speaker: ETHAN
audio_lines.line: Sloane is moving into the guest room. Don’t make it awkward.

audio_lines.speaker: CLAIRE
audio_lines.line: Since when?

audio_lines.speaker: ETHAN
audio_lines.line: Since I got tired of pretending. You just cook and nod.

audio_lines.speaker: SLOANE
audio_lines.line: Sorry, Claire. Love finds a way.

audio_lines.speaker: CLAIRE
audio_lines.line: Of course. I’ll make up the room.

audio_lines.speaker: CLAIRE
audio_lines.line: Six months of playing broken. One more night, and he’ll never see it coming.

beats.action: Moving In: INT. WHITMORE PENTHOUSE, KITCHEN. EVENING. Claire stirs soup as the front door slams. Close-up: Claire’s hand tightens on the ladle, then relaxes.

beats.summary: Mother’s Pearls: INT. WHITMORE PENTHOUSE, DINING ROOM. NIGHT. Sloane sits in Claire’s chair, wearing a pearl necklace. Close-up: Claire’s bare throat, her pearl earrings catching the candlelight.

audio_lines.speaker: SLOANE
audio_lines.line: Ethan gave me these pearls. Aren’t they gorgeous?

audio_lines.speaker: CLAIRE
audio_lines.line: They were my mother’s.

audio_lines.speaker: ETHAN
audio_lines.line: Then she’d be happy someone worthy finally wears them.

audio_lines.speaker: SLOANE
audio_lines.line: She isn’t even angry, Ethan. How boring.

audio_lines.speaker: ETHAN
audio_lines.line: The board is thrilled. Next quarter, I’m taking Whitmore Tech public.

audio_lines.speaker: CLAIRE
audio_lines.line: That’s wonderful, darling. You’ve worked so hard.

audio_lines.speaker: CLAIRE
audio_lines.line: Wear them tonight. They’re mine again by morning.

beats.action: Mother’s Pearls: INT. WHITMORE PENTHOUSE, DINING ROOM. NIGHT. Sloane sits in Claire’s chair, wearing a pearl necklace. Close-up: Claire’s bare throat, her pearl earrings catching the candlelight.

beats.summary: Pass the Salt: INT. WHITMORE PENTHOUSE, DINING ROOM. NIGHT. Close-up: Claire’s phone glows under the table, reading “Final transfer: 98%.” Macro shot: the phone reads “TRANSFER COMPLETE.” The doorbell rings.

audio_lines.speaker: ETHAN
audio_lines.line: I built this company from nothing. Remember that, Claire.

audio_lines.speaker: CLAIRE
audio_lines.line: Nothing? My father built it. You just borrowed it.

audio_lines.speaker: CLAIRE
audio_lines.line: Pass the salt, please?

audio_lines.speaker: ETHAN
audio_lines.line: Anything for my loyal wife.

audio_lines.speaker: CLAIRE
audio_lines.line: Enjoy this dinner, Ethan. It’s your last as a rich man.

audio_lines.speaker: ETHAN
audio_lines.line: Funny. You should try comedy.

audio_lines.speaker: SLOANE
audio_lines.line: Poor thing. She really thinks she’s funny.
